content: Sapwellimen Koht Inou ong Noha
Koht ahpw ketin kupwuramwahwiheki Noha oh nah pwutak ko mahsen wet: “Kumwail kaparaparala pwe kadaudokamwail kan en kousoanla wasa koaros nin sampah.
Mahn koaros en sampah, iangahki menpihr kan oh mwahmw akan, pahn lammwikin kumwail. Koaros pahn mi pahn amwail manaman.
Kumwail kak tungoale soahng me momour koaros oh pil tuhke koaros. I kihong kumwail koaros pwe kumwail en wiahki amwail mehn tungoal.
Ihte me kumwail sohte pahn tungoalehn: uduk me mie nta, I sohte mweidada pwehki mour mi nan nta.
Mehmen me pahn kihsang amwail mour, I pahn kalokehki mehla, oh I pahn kauwehla mahn emen me pahn kemeikumwailla.
Mehmen me pahn kemehla aramas, e pahn kamakamala rehn aramas; pwe aramas wiawihda rasehng Koht.
“Kumwail eri kaparaparala pwe kadaudokamwail kan en tohtohla oh kousoanla wasa koaros nin sampah.”
Koht pil mahsanihong Noha oh nah pwutak ko,
“Eri, met I pahn kauwada ei inou rehmwail oh rehn kadaudokamwail kan,
oh pil rehn mahn mour koaros me mi rehmwail—menpihr kan oh mahn akan—oh mehkoaros me kohieisang nan warihmwo.
Eri, iet audepen ei inou en: I inoukihda me I solahr pahn pwurehng kauwehkihla nohlik lapalap soahng me momour kan nin sampah. Solahr pil ehu nohlik lapalap pahn wiawi pwe en kauwehla sampah.
Eri, iet kilel poatopoat en ei inou ong kumwail oh ong soahng me momour kan koaros:
ahia pwoat me I padokadahng nan depwek kan. Ih me pahn wia kilel en ei inou ong sampah.
Ahnsou koaros me I pahn kapwarehda depwek pohn sampah oh ahia pwoat pahn sansal nan depwek kan,
I pahn kin tamanda ei inou ong kumwail oh ong mahn akan koaros, duwen nohlik lapalap eh solahr pahn wiawi pwe en kauwehla soahng me momour kan koaros nin sampah.
Eri, ni ahia eh pahn kin pwarada nan depwek kan, I pahn kin kilang oh tamanda inou poatopoat wet me mie nanpwungen ngehi oh soahng me momour kan koaros nin sampah.”
Koht ahpw pil mahsanihong Noha, “Ih met kilel en inou me I padokadahr nanpwungen ngehi oh soahng me momour kan koaros nin sampah.”
Noha oh Nah Pwutak kan
Nein Noha ko me iang kohieisang nan warihmwo, iei Sehm, Ahm (semen Kenan), oh Saped.
Nein Noha pwukat silimen iei irail me semen aramas koaros nin sampah.
Noha, ohlen wia sapwasapw men. Ih me tepin wiahda mwetuwel en wain ehu.
Mwurin eh tungoale wain en eh mwetuwelo, e ahpw sakaula mehlel oh kilisouda wendiong nan imwe impwalo.
Eri, Ahm, semen Kenan, ni eh kilangada duwen semeo eh kilisou, e ahpw kohla oh padahkihong rie ko, Sehm oh Saped.
Sehm oh Saped eri ale likou reirei ehu, kidahng pohn pwopwara oh kahsekirla nan impwalo oh pwaindi samarao. Masara ko sohsohpeisangete pwe ira dehr kilang samarao ni eh kilisou.
Ni waino eh sarada oh Noha eri esehda dahme nah me tikitiko wiahiong,
e ahpw patohwan,

content.text: E pahn wiahla lidun rie kan.
Kaping ong KAUN-O, Koht en Sehm!
Kadaudoke kan en kousoanla rehn nein Sehm kan!

content: Eri, mwurin nohlik lapalapo, Noha pil momourki sounpar 350.
E ahpw sipalla ni eh sounpar 950.

footnotes.text: 9.27 SAPED: Sisen ahd wet ekis duwehte sisen lepin mahsen en Ipru me wehwehki “kaparaparala.”
